column3: 63.  (1)  The  Zones  SL  shall  in  the  performance  and

column2: discharge of its duties and functions, exercise the following

column3: to conduct studies it deems necessary to decide on
the need for the creation or expansion of investment
zones;
to  make  recommendations  to  the  Economic
Commission  on  the  need  for  or  expansion  of
investment  zones;
operate and manage investment zones on behalf of
the Government of Sri Lanka in accordance with
the provisions of this Part and create the necessary
infrastructure  containing  state  of  the  art  facilities
for  investments  located  therein  including  roads,
electric power, water supply, housing and such other
facilities and amenities as required and implement
such  concessions  and  exercise  such  powers  and
discharge such functions as delegated to it by the
Economic Commission under this Act;
to  carry  out  detailed  studies  for  the  economic
development projects through investment zones;
to establish and enhance the cooperation between
inter  agencies  of  every  Ministry,  department,
provincial  council,  provincial  ministry  and
department  and  local  authority  and  other  persons
or  body  of  persons  whether  private  or  public  in
carrying  out  studies  and  implementation  of
investment zones and special development areas;
to  supervise  and  regulate  the  management  of
investment  zones;
